summary.text: Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress is a rank eight Immortal Gu House built from more than twenty Immortal Gu. In a dream realm Wu Shuai relies on it and learns its three killer moves, led by accumulated soil mountain.

claims.text: Under Red Porcelain Lightning Ball Tribulation, the host is earth path rank eight Zheng Yang, who has poured every Immortal Gu he owns into this damaged house and calls its defensive power first in history. The structure uses a hundred million Gu worms, and no core Immortal Gu stands out at a glance. After repeated explorations the explorer gains accumulated soil mountain, peaceful burial, and heavy soil comeback. The first is an earth path killer move with formation path effect that stacks earth path Gu worms into an Immortal Gu House even with zero formation path attainment, and gaining it is gaining the foundation of the house. The house core is that immortal killer move rather than a core Immortal Gu. No usable offensive methods show up while the house is being learned.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment, not a five-region map seat.

Fang Yuan already means to build a third Immortal Gu House focused on defense and healing for the fate Gu battle, able to resist even venerable methods to an extent, and he settles on earth path Immortal Gu for that role. He does not yet know that clone Wu Shuai has already obtained a creation method for an earth path Immortal Gu House from dream realm exploration, and that this house is called Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress and suits those requirements.

Fang Yuan takes out rank eight Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress in battle: a layered yellowish-brown mountain like a tower of giant drums, smooth on the surface and wrapped in misty sand. It is an earth path Immortal Gu House whose core is immortal killer moves rather than a core Immortal Gu, with three core killer moves and accumulated soil mountain as the most important. Each such fortress can look different, and even one fortress can change form and abilities when different earth path Gu worms are used. He obtained the complete blueprint from the dream realm, gained many earth path Immortal Gu from the blue dragon whale, and already had this rank eight house before the fate war. Its speed ranks at the bottom among Immortal Gu Houses, only superior to immortal formations, while its defense keeps it unmovable under Spectral Soul’s attack.

The house needs heavy immortal essence and is suited to attrition: Gu Immortals can heal inside, analyze enemy killer moves, and waste the enemy’s immortal essence behind its defense. It also lacks offensive methods. After damage, activating accumulated soil mountain lets countless earth path Gu worms enter and fully recover the house in three breaths while reshaping it, because the killer-move core lets added earth path Gu merge with high stability and even alter the tower’s properties. Demon Immortal Qi Jue judges its defense likely the highest among Immortal Gu Houses that currently exist.

After Dragon Palace and Myriad Year Flying Warship are lost, Fang Yuan immediately fields Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress; the three houses are rank eight peak creations of enslavement path, time path, and earth path.
The house remains, but blocking Spectral Soul’s self-detonation costs Fang Yuan seven earth path Immortal Gu and countless mortal Gu, and Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress is heavily weakened.
With Cooking Luck Pot and Thieves Den, it is one of the three main Immortal Gu Houses Fang Yuan focuses on then.
